A species of poison-type Pokémon consisting of two linked, round, charcoal-grey bodies. Each body has a single, small, pale yellow eye and a wide, grinning mouth; it lacks hair, ears, or wings, and possesses no fingers. The twin bodies are connected by a thick, fleshy grey bridge, and each body has a single, small, grey stubby foot. No tail.
BODY COLOR: charcoal-grey
